name: overlap-dedup
description:
Two tasks' latest reports overlap on one host: 10.5.0.2 appears in both. Without cross-report dedup the run emitted the same foreign id greenbone:10.5.0.2 twice in one run (last-write churn per poll, and a unique_ids violation). The run-level seen-set must import the host once, count the duplicate, and still import the hosts unique to each report.

namespaced_ids is skipped because the foreign id is greenbone:{ip} with no appliance scope -- a known limitation of the id scheme, which is out of scope to change.

log_contains: greenbone: report bbbbbbbb skipped 1 host(s) already imported by an earlier report this run
